lobby.title: Meet in the courtyard
lobby.explanation: Create a room and share its invitation, or enter the code from your friend. Set the rules together before the match.
lobby.codeHint: Use eight letters or digits from the invitation.

matchResult.abandoned: The match ended after both players left.
matchResult.roundWinsConfigured: {{player}} wins the match with {{wins}} round wins.
matchResult.roundWinConfigured: {{player}} wins the match with one round win.

rematch.locked: Rematch opens after the result hold.
rematch.needsPlayers: Both players must be present for a rematch.

settings.title: Match rules
settings.explanation: These rules apply to both players and every round in this match.
settings.speedCap: Speed pickups add one level at a time, up to 5 cells/s.
settings.heartDescription: Absorbs one lethal blast, then grants a brief damage grace period.
settings.piercingBombDescription: Stores one special bomb whose blast passes through breakable blocks. The charge is used only when you successfully place it.
settings.powerBombDescription: Stores one special bomb whose blast fills a diamond-shaped area, ignoring obstruction while leaving hard walls intact. The charge is used only when you successfully place it.
settings.shieldDescription: Grants 5 seconds of damage immunity. Picking up another Shield refreshes it.
settings.goldenFlameDescription: Maximizes new bomb blasts for 10 seconds. Picking up another Golden flame refreshes it.
settings.shortFuseDescription: Halves the fuse of new bombs for 10 seconds. Picking up another Short fuse refreshes it.
settings.diarrheaDescription: Automatically drops ordinary bombs for 10 seconds whenever placement is possible and you have spare capacity. Another pickup refreshes the timer.
settings.slowFootDescription: Halves movement speed for 10 seconds. Up to 6 pickups stack, and each has its own timer.
settings.shortFlameDescription: Limits new bomb blasts to 1 tile for 10 seconds, overriding Golden flame. Existing bombs stay unchanged; range bonuses resume afterward. Another pickup refreshes it.
settings.longFuseDescription: Doubles the fuse of new bombs for 10 seconds. Short and Long fuse cancel while both are active; existing bombs stay unchanged. Another pickup refreshes it.
settings.reverseControlsDescription: Reverses movement controls for 10 seconds. Held keys stay physically held; another pickup refreshes the timer.
settings.unapplied: Apply these changes before readying up.
settings.lockedReady: Become not ready to edit the rules.
settings.lockedMatch: Rules are locked after the match starts.

connection.disconnected: Choose how to enter a room.
connection.reconnecting: Restoring your place in the match…

reconnect.title: Connection interrupted
reconnect.retrying: The courtyard remains as you last saw it while your seat is restored. Controls will return after a fresh game state arrives.
reconnect.resultHeld: The next round will wait for both players to reconnect.

arena.label: Grenadiers courtyard
arena.failure: The courtyard could not be drawn. Leave the room and try again.
arena.focusHint: Select the courtyard to control your player.
arena.instructions: Move with the arrow keys or W A S D. Place a bomb with Space. Controls work only during a live round.

controls.title: Keyboard controls
controls.explanation: Choose Change, then press one physical key. Custom controls are saved in this browser.
controls.captureHint: Press an allowed key, or Escape to cancel. Tab still moves focus.
controls.unsupported: Use an arrow, letter, number, Space, or Enter without modifier keys.
controls.instructions: Move with {{movement}}. Place a bomb with {{bomb}}. Controls work only during a live round.

error.title: Could not complete that action
error.connectionFailed: The game connection ended. Try again.
error.invalidServerMessage: The server sent game data this version cannot use.
error.sessionFailed: A game session could not be created. Try again.
error.sequenceExhausted: This connection reached its command limit. Start a new session.
error.incompatibleProtocol: This game version is not supported by the server.
error.invalidMessage: The server could not understand that command.
error.authenticationFailed: This game session is no longer valid.
error.connectionInUse: This session is already open elsewhere.
error.alreadyAuthenticated: This connection is already signed in.
error.roomNotFound: That room is no longer available.
error.staleRoom: The room changed before the command arrived.
error.staleSequence: That command arrived out of order.
error.capacityReached: The server has no room for another match.
error.resumeRejected: This reserved seat is no longer available.
error.staleSettings: The match rules changed. Review the latest values and try again.
error.settingsLocked: Only the current rules editor can change settings before the match.
error.seatReplaced: This seat was resumed in another tab.
